title: Retire generic DNA and thymus aliases from the fish-sperm DNA owner
body:
The fish-sperm DNA owner retains ten exact aliases copied from generic DNA, including unqualified DNA and thymus nucleic acid. Its whole identity is source-specific fish-sperm material, and its ontology grounding to CHEBI:16991 is asymmetric. The inspected four SERVA source occurrences establish fish-sperm DNA, not generic DNA of every biological source or a thymus product.

Reviewed W05 head `43f7cf6e8681fa617b5d6d3529d94d537ca01f0d`, frozen base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. The preserved external review is `20261108T071144Z-worker08-independent-worker05-full188-payload138`, YAML SHA256 `bdde7d4101546e0e43f0752e4587c4d0c3a0fb43f887d82eee2d869edd5c06b0`. All 188 case-decision hashes and all 138 selected payload hashes were independently rebound to the published core; the sealed scientific review remains needs_curation. This comment records bounded follow-up before author correction, not approval or application.

- `MATERIALS-C1193-fish-sperm-dna`: `data/ingredients/mapped/Fish-sperm_Dna.yaml`, before `b58a13acec7b840f5b8f13fe70630055cfe14da2d78e07538439ea1aac1b7893`, proposed `0f355235eec4e7f909d0a5675291872f899dd69fdd331d7b30b77d4f3ec55aaf`; [exact published payload](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/43f7cf6e8681fa617b5d6d3529d94d537ca01f0d/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-05/correction-1193-v1/materials/proposed-v2/Fish-sperm_Dna.yaml).

- `synonyms/9`: `thymus nucleic acid` (kg_microbe).

Retain the fish-sperm/SERVA source identity and reject the unsupported generic-DNA or conflicting-thymus exact-identity aliases with raw provenance preserved. Do not infer species, length/counterion, reverse the herring tombstone or resurrect the false absent-formula/class premise of #322. Preserve all original captures, history, known source/form/role and supported-versus-withheld holds. Use existing guarded proposal validation and independent review; no new code, test, schema, threshold, owner-selection rule, merge, corpus publication or approval transfer is authorized by this finding.

[ChEBI:16991](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?obo_id=CHEBI:16991) defines generic DNA; exact capture SHA256 `f6c9cb13ae152ed197e62ffc7636970a0619e657da3fcef55c80ccc5dbf4193d`. The original four TOGO recipes M2450–M2453 and exact field/provenance bindings are in W05 materials evidence and the independent review. The fresh native policy probe confirms these ten exact labels remain eligible; this does not claim a newly rebuilt released consumer index.

Deduplication: fresh indexed Fish-sperm search returned #870/#882/#170/#226. Full bodies/comments concern stale node pointers, tombstones, directory placement and historical merges, not this exact ten-alias scope. #322 explicitly corrected its unsupported absent-formula heuristic. Preserve those authentic decisions; do not reopen the herring merge or assume a generic class is invalid because it lacks a molecular formula. No exact current alias tracker was found in the captured all-state bodies and relevant indexed/comment scope.
